name: Pre Trade Output Market Data Report V 01
definition: The PreTradeOutputMarketDataReport message is sent by the Consolidated Tape Provider, based on data submitted by Trading Venues, in accordance with local regulations. The message contains consolidated pre-trade transparency data for financial instruments, including aggregated bid and ask prices, order sizes, type of auction, and timestamps.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Provides general information on the pre-trade core output data report.

OutputDataReport.name: Output Data Report
OutputDataReport.definition: Report related to the output of pre-trade transparency data for financial instruments.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
